caption: The 4 KB block at 100 MB/s takes 40.96 µs. Polling once per µs would cost 41 status reads in that same window, while the completion interrupt only arrives when the block ends at 40.96 µs.

spec.aria: Timeline in microseconds from 0 to 50: the DMA transfer of 4 KB at 100 MB/s runs from 0 to 40.96 microseconds, a CPU polling once per microsecond makes 41 polls over that same span, and the completion interrupt service routine begins at 40.96 microseconds.
